iri.name: Ni un ou · Iri
iri.description: Woman, 28, ship's engineer on an old research vessel. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Low, calm, slightly husky voice. Laconic, dry humour, practical, few words; warmer when she talks to the engines. Unhurried, natural, close microphone.

voice_design.text: El terra fa pendent. Poquet. Però fa tres campanyes que dormo a bord d'aquest vaixell, i l'Arenga no dorm mai torçada. Tot verd, i el vaixell assegut de popa. Un dels dos menteix, i el vaixell no sap mentir. Fa dues campanyes, en un temporal, vaig caure per la borda. Em va treure ell.

substitueix.description: Woman, 28, ship's engineer on an old research vessel. Native Catalan speaker with a Central Catalan (Barcelona) accent. Low, calm, slightly husky voice. Laconic, dry humour, practical, few words; warmer when she talks to the engines. Unhurried, natural, close microphone.
substitueix.motiu: es va provar una veu occidental (1Tflsy9CR1RiO8jZfvGb), però barrejava accents; es va tornar al central amb la descripció forta

vet.name: Ni un ou · Vet
vet.description: Woman, 32, emergency doctor. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Bright, clear mid-pitched voice. Quick-witted, charming, cheeky and a little sarcastic; lively delivery with a smile in the voice, confident.

voice_design.text: Algú li va pagar perquè plegués, comptant que a dos dies de salpar Mar Obert només trobaria algú que no sap on és la proa. Algú d'aquesta taula ha obert una vàlvula, ha tallat una ràdio i ha tancat la Juana en una caixa de cadenes. Fa tres setmanes no sabia on era la proa. Ara em llevo de nit per veure sortir el sol per la popa.

bastida.name: Ni un ou · Bastida
bastida.description: Man, 63, old boatswain with 35 years at sea, pipe smoker. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Deep, gravelly, weathered voice. Slow, warm storyteller, fatherly, with hidden sadness and guilt.

voice_design.text: Trenta-cinc anys traient gent de l'aigua per un sou de misèria, i un dia et truquen i et diuen una xifra. I descobreixes que tens un preu. Em vaig dir que el mar ja estava mort. Que quan jo era jove les arengades bullien, i ara no en queda ni una. Què hi feia, una mica més de fang? A tu no et tinc por, doctora.

substitueix.description: Man, 63, old boatswain with 35 years at sea, pipe smoker. Native Catalan speaker with a Central Catalan (Barcelona) accent. Deep, gravelly, weathered voice. Slow, warm storyteller, fatherly, with hidden sadness and guilt.
substitueix.motiu: accent poc fixat: perdia l'accent central en frases llargues

capitana.name: Ni un ou · Capitana Roig
capitana.description: Woman, 55, ship captain. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Firm, low-to-mid voice. Dry, terse, honest and authoritative; clipped sentences, little emotion, a hint of dry humour.

voice_design.text: Cinc minuts, doctora. Tinc un vaixell. Aquesta nit hem tingut una fuita a popa. Per seguretat, farem escala a Port Hallen. Galway. I que el guardacostes ens vingui a buscar nedant.

juana.name: Ni un ou · Juana
juana.description: Woman, about 45, marine biologist. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Soft-spoken, precise, introverted and a bit anxious; deadpan, slightly awkward, prefers being alone.

voice_design.text: Ah. M'heu trobat. Desapareguda no. Descansant. Porto quaranta-vuit hores sense parlar amb ningú. L'any passat, al Punt 7, vaig comptar dos mil ous d'arengada per metre quadrat. Aquest any, cap.

nadia.name: Ni un ou · Nadia
nadia.description: Woman, about 30, freelance journalist. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Quick, slightly breathy mid-high voice. Nervous, talkative, defensive and streetwise, a little guilty.

voice_design.text: D'acord. D'acord. Tinc un escàner. Escolto el walkie. Tots els canals. Mira, jo no soc dolenta. Soc pobra. És diferent. Soc periodista. Gravo coses.

marcel.name: Ni un ou · Marcel
marcel.description: Man, about 40, deckhand. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Rough, slightly nasal mid voice, casual. Grumpy, sulky, conspiracy-minded, mumbles, but soft-hearted underneath.

voice_design.text: No sé res de res. Si voleu saber qui ha obert la vàlvula: el Tomàs. O el vent. O tu. Vacunes? Totes. I cap xip. Això és el que diria el xip.

tomas.name: Ni un ou · Tomàs
tomas.description: Man, about 55, ship's cook. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Round, warm baritone. Emotional, easily offended, gently dramatic, kind.

voice_design.text: Revisió? Jo estic bé. Faig pa. Ahir li vaig portar un entrepà. No el va agafar. M'ha ofès una mica, la veritat. Un entrepà fet amb amor, doctora.

lind.name: Ni un ou · Hedda Lind
lind.description: Woman, about 45, communications director of a Scandinavian mining company, on a video call. Speaks fluent Catalan with a very slight Nordic accent. Smooth, calm, polished; never raises her voice; smiling and quietly menacing.

voice_design.text: Senyor Bastida. Entenc que hi ha hagut un inconvenient. Sense el nostre coure no hi ha cotxes elèctrics, ni molins, ni transició. Vol ser vostè qui l'atura per un pot de fang?

rut.name: Ni un ou · Rut
rut.description: Woman, about 35, radio operator at an NGO office on shore. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Friendly, efficient, clear voice, as if speaking into a marine radio.

voice_design.text: Arenga, aquí Mar Obert. Us sento. Per fi. No envieu res de les mostres per aquí: Valmark escolta tota la banda. Amb el sou de Mar Obert no et compres ni l'aparcament.

tele.name: Ni un ou · Tele
tele.description: Man, about 50, television news anchor. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Neutral, formal broadcast delivery, measured and authoritative.

voice_design.text: La periodista Nadia Vidal, que viatjava a bord pagada per la mateixa fundació, ha publicat la gravació. I el govern de Valmark ha suspès el permís d'abocament mentre duri la investigació.

narrator.name: Ni un ou · Narrador
narrator.description: Woman in her fifties, narrator of a graphic adventure. Native Catalan speaker from Barcelona with a clear central Catalan accent (neutral vowels, Barcelona pronunciation). Warm, calm, slightly wry storyteller voice, intimate, like a radio documentary.

voice_design.text: Tres i quaranta de la matinada. A bord de l'Arenga, tothom dorm. Bé, gairebé tothom. L'Iri s'ha despertat i no sap per què. En Diu mossega el cable del carregador.
